items.q: And Joe and Sonny were two of the most colorful characters in the band, which was full of colorful characters.

ctx.x: I have that album with the arrangements right on the “Basie Swings” and the —

Yeah and “Joe Williams Sings Basie Swings” yes, yes, that was— Thad Jones also did some wonderful work for Joe, as well as Ernie Wilkins. Ernie Wilkins, he wrote the big, the arrangement on the big hit “Every Day” and there was another one called “Five O’clock in the Morning.”
